title: A path the user gave must be made absolute in the adapter's process before it crosses to another process
rule: When a CLI, MCP or plugin adapter sends a user-given file or folder path (an --out, an export folder, a source) through fm-api, make it absolute with std::path::absolute in the adapter's own process before building the request, and run every local check (exists, --force) on that same absolute path. In endpoint mode the running app serves the call and resolves a relative path against its own working folder, so the file lands elsewhere and a local existence check is about another file. Test it with the built binary run from a temp working folder against an endpoint over MockApi and a relative path, and assert the path the API got is in that folder.
rationale: E26.6 (#169): `fm specimen --out rel.html` sent the relative path to the app in endpoint mode; the app wrote it in its own working folder, past the --force check that looked in fm's folder.
